sents.zh: 一百多年以前，上海还只是一个小地方。
sents.en: A hundred years ago and more, Shanghai was still only a small place.

sents.zh: 因为它在海边，所以后来很多船来了。
sents.en: Because it lies by the sea, many ships later came.

sents.zh: 很多国家的人在这里住了下来。
sents.en: People from many countries settled there.

sents.zh: 他们带来了新的东西和新的想法。
sents.en: They brought new things and new ideas.
And newspapers that came out every day.

sents.zh: 路上开始有车，还有很多店。
sents.en: Cars appeared in the streets, and many shops.

sents.zh: 晚上路上很亮，一直到很晚都有人。
sents.en: At night the streets were bright, with people out until late.

sents.zh: 老的中国和新的东西都在这个城里。
sents.en: The old China and the new things were both in this city.

sents.zh: 有的人觉得很好，有的人觉得不好。
sents.en: Some thought it good, some did not.

sents.zh: 有的人在这里做买卖，得到了很多钱。
sents.en: Some traded here and made a great deal of money.

sents.zh: 也有很多人过得非常难。
sents.en: And many others lived very hard lives.

sents.zh: 所以上海是一个又新又难的地方。
sents.en: So Shanghai was a place both new and hard.

sents.zh: 它的变化，就是那时候中国的变化。
sents.en: Its change was China’s change in those years.
